name: Trinkets...
summary: After Set Them Ablaze!, a chest called the Hoard of the Black Dragonflight waits for you in Searing Gorge. It looks locked.

sections.title: A Locked Chest
sections.body: The Hoard of the Black Dragonflight looks to be locked, and it is yours to open. The chest comes into being once the towers of Searing Gorge are burning.

sections.title: At Your Touch
sections.body: The chest gives way at your touch, with no key needed. Inside lies a black dragonflight molt. A passing thought wonders how much cheese could be in there, and the only way to learn is to look.

faq.q: What is the Hoard of the Black Dragonflight?
aliases: what is hoard of the black dragonflight
faq.answer: A chest in Searing Gorge that appears after Set Them Ablaze!. It looks to be locked.
Set Them Ablaze!, the fire-setting against the towers of Searing Gorge.

faq.q: What are you asked to do with the chest?
aliases: what to do with the chest
faq.answer: Open it. The chest looks locked, but opening it is all that is asked of you.
